admission: D-B simultaneous lower bound>0 on both IID/OOD, completed-job accuracy noninferior, native semantic and causal audit qualified, and CPU-adjusted difference positive at0.01 utility/CPU-second with training amortized over1000 sessions. Failure or missing evidence remains a blocker.
cell_training: Four fixed-budget next-observation gradient steps, then six masked task-Q gradient steps through the entire causal recurrence, alternating with 600 critic updates. Both families use 11 parameters, equal central-difference evaluation counts, the same minibatch indices and initialization. Actual CPU costs are retained.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum full-task fitted-law Bellman action regret on validation only; first checkpoint wins ties. Select all cell and critic parameters jointly. No test or OOD inspection before the model freeze.
column_control: Both controller columns use the same family model. Fixed versus value changes only action selection. No myopic-Q column is relabeled fixed.
fixed_rule: FIRE if legal and confidence>=0.8 or READ is illegal; otherwise READ if legal; otherwise STOP. Cell state is still propagated and measured. This column cannot identify a cell-signal effect on actions, since the boundary uses exact posterior only.
normalization: Public 62 coordinates use TRAIN means/std, std<1e-8 replaced by1. Cell5 use mean0.5/std0.5. No clipping including OOD.
scientific_scope: Native owner policy selection and real FullHX reads on a synthetic two-job task; finite regenerative CTMC versus ordinary gated cells; no claim of a new deployed production network or global optimum
source_freeze: Freeze protocol and selected model hashes before generating heldout data; preserve every failed/partial attempt and report preparation, native startup, training and execution costs separately. Root verifies publication and source identity.
target: Absolute masked Q from the exact finite Bellman recursion for TRAIN-calibrated observation law, including later job after FIRE/reset/refractory; not realized clairvoyant packet outcomes.
task_objective: Correct-minus-incorrect terminal reward minus priced READ queries minus declared elapsed-task latency; measured hardware CPU enters a separate all-cost sensitivity, including training amortization.
uncertainty: Five paired independent training fits; two-sided Student t confidence intervals, Bonferroni five contrasts separately for IID/OOD. Sessions are not independent training replications.
